NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Unaudited quarterly and reported FY2025 financial statements
Published January 10, 2026.
Reporting basis: IFRS; entity perimeter: consolidated group.
Currency: USD; amounts in millions. Expenses are presented by function.
This source reports four discrete calendar 2025 quarters and independently reported FY2025 annual totals for January 1-December 31, 2025 (365 days). No FY2024 annual income statement or prior-year quarterly series is supplied.
The opening balance is December 31, 2024. The quarters are January 1-March 31 (90 days), April 1-June 30 (91 days), July 1-September 30 (92 days), and October 1-December 31 (92 days).
Each quarter cost of sales is 15, gross profit is 15, and selling/general/administrative operating expenses including depreciation are 8.75 (7.5 excluding depreciation plus 1.25 depreciation). Other operating expenses are zero. Total operating costs including cost of sales and depreciation are 23.75; these totals are distinct from function-only operating expenses of 8.75.
FY2025 cost of sales is 60, gross profit is 60, selling/general/administrative operating expenses including depreciation are 35, depreciation is 5, and total operating costs including cost of sales and depreciation are 95.
No EBITDA adjustments or add-backs occurred in any quarter or FY2025; this disclosure is complete.
One operating segment, Consolidated Operations, reports revenue of 30 in each quarter and 120 in FY2025; there are no corporate or elimination segments.
No acquisitions, disposals, net equity movements, equity issuance, equity repurchases, leases, operating lease costs, lease cash payments, lease payments in financing, interest paid in financing, or other investing/financing cash flows occurred in any quarter or FY2025. Each such flow is explicitly zero.
There were no pro-forma adjustments, subsequent events, FX cash movements, or noncash debt changes through January 10, 2026.
Cash interest and cash taxes are classified in operating cash flows. Capital expenditure is entirely maintenance investment; growth capex is zero.
Operational KPIs and source-reported unlevered free cash flow are not disclosed.
Opening and quarterly/FY closing balance sheets are presented on page 4.
Restricted cash, short-term investments, other current assets, goodwill, other intangibles, short-term debt, current portion of long-term debt, unsecured debt, subordinated debt, pensions, lease obligations and minority interests are each zero at opening and every quarter/FY end.
There is no revolving credit facility: RCF commitment and RCF drawings are each zero at opening and every quarter/FY end.
The complete equity roll-forward in each quarter consists only of net profit 4 and dividends paid (2.25); FY2025 consists only of net profit 16 and dividends paid (9). Other comprehensive income and every other equity movement were zero throughout these periods: no capital contributions, share issuance, repurchases, revaluations, currency translation, perimeter changes, reserve transfers or other equity adjustments occurred.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Complete facility and classification schedule
Published January 10, 2026. USD millions; consolidated group; IFRS carrying values.
There is exactly one debt facility: Northbridge Term Loan, facility_id term-loan.
It is a senior secured term loan, not a lease. No other debt facilities or debt adjustments exist.
Date                 Carrying value  Principal  Drawn amount  Commitment
2024-12-31           45              45         45            50
2025-03-31           46.25           46.25      46.25         50
2025-06-30           47.5            47.5       47.5          50
2025-09-30           48.75           48.75      48.75         50
2025-12-31           50              50         50            50
The carrying value equals principal and drawn amount; there are no fees, unamortized adjustments or other carrying-value adjustments.
The facility has floating rate type with SOFR reference rate, spread 0 basis points and floor 0 basis points. Fixed coupon is not applicable. Mandatory annual amortisation is 0; final maturity is December 31, 2029. Cash interest amounts in the quarterly statements are reported cash payments, not a forecast calculation from the terms.
FY2025 and Q4 share the same December 31, 2025 closing facility balance of 50. No leases, unsecured debt, revolving commitments or revolving drawings exist at any reporting date.
Reported EBITDA equals revenue less cost of sales less function-only operating expenses including depreciation plus depreciation and amortization. Each reported quarter and FY2025 use this definition. Adjusted EBITDA equals reported EBITDA because there are no adjustments.
CFO equals net profit plus depreciation and amortization plus the signed working-capital cash movement.
Net cash change equals operating cash flow plus net investing cash flow plus net financing cash flow.
Cash movement equals closing cash less opening cash. Debt movement equals net cash debt issuance with zero noncash change.
